translations.web: ‘Cursed is he who secretly kills his neighbor.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
translations.bsb: ‘Cursed is he who strikes down his neighbor in secret.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
translations.kjv: Cursed be he that smiteth his neighbour secretly. And all the people shall say, Amen.
translations.asv: Cursed be he that smiteth his neighbor in secret. And all the people shall say, Amen.
